clue.text: Duty-free post

parts.note: read not as a tax-exempt job but as a position that carries no duties at all, a paid job with nothing to do

explanation.surface: A job at an airport shop selling untaxed goods.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Duty-free' suggests customs and shopping; here it means a post with no work attached.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names an office that pays a salary while requiring little or no work.

clue.text: It stays green, so looking neat

explanation.surface: Something is always fresh and so always tidy.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses: an evergreen conifer, and smart, trim in appearance.

clue.text: Recording, but making no sound!

parts.note: recording usually suggests sound on tape, but here it is the silent act of writing something down

explanation.surface: A tape recorder that captures silence.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Recording' suggests audio; the silent kind is jotting down in writing.
explanation.definitionFit: Writing down or observing something is registering it in notes.

clue.text: Firm about a letter with strings attached

indicators.note: the firm's letters go around the letter piece

parts.note: Co is the abbreviation for company, a firm
ell is the spelt name of the letter L

explanation.surface: A company writing a letter on conditions.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with strings attached' suggests conditions; it is an instrument that literally has strings.
explanation.definitionFit: A bowed instrument of the violin family that has four strings.

clue.text: Formality in the matter of help

parts.note: re means concerning, in the matter of
to serve is to help or assist

explanation.surface: Official procedure concerning assistance.
explanation.definitionFit: Reticence and formal restraint in manner is a cool coolness.

clue.text: Direct loan-making

indicators.note: the letters of the first word are used for making something new, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: An instruction to set up a loan directly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'making' tells you to rearrange DIRECT; the six letters reorder into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Money advanced to a borrower on trust to repay later is a form of finance lending.

clue.text: A story with point for members of the family

parts.note: a relation is a narrative or account, a story
S is south, a point of the compass

explanation.surface: A tale with a moral for the family.
explanation.definitionFit: Kin or relatives are those connected by blood or marriage.

clue.text: Legally seize the goods appearing first in the pipe-line

indicators.note: the letters go inside the pipe-line word

parts.note: a drain is a pipe that carries waste away
is means exists, appearing present

indicators.note: the first letter of the word the is taken

explanation.surface: Bailiffs taking possessions found at the start of a pipeline.
explanation.walkthrough: IS plus T (first of 'the') goes inside DRAIN.
explanation.definitionFit: A legal term for seizing someone's property to recover a debt.

clue.text: Deter the drunk-should be kept in check

indicators.note: being drunk, the words deter the are jumbled up

explanation.surface: Restrain the drunkard; he needs controlling.
explanation.walkthrough: 'drunk' looks like a person; it rearranges DETER THE.
explanation.definitionFit: Tied up and restrained, like an animal on a rope, is restricted.

clue.text: Naomi was never anything but kind

parts.note: in the Book of Ruth, Naomi's daughter-in-law Ruth refused to leave her, so Naomi was never without her
never being without someone is to be 'minus' them never, the suffix meaning without

explanation.surface: A comment on the unfailing gentleness of a biblical woman.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface praises Naomi's kindness; cryptically, Naomi was never 'Ruth-less', because Ruth stayed with her ('Whither thou goest, I will go').
explanation.definitionFit: Someone pitiless and cruel is the very opposite of kind.

clue.text: Near the end of August there's little room

parts.note: close means near

indicators.note: the end of a word is its final letter, taken here from August

explanation.surface: Late in August there is hardly any space left.
explanation.definitionFit: A cupboard or small private chamber is a small enclosed space.

clue.text: Collect some of the apples that fall

indicators.note: only some of the letters of the apples are taken, running across them

explanation.surface: Gathering windfall apples.
explanation.definitionFit: To pile up or gather together is to amass.

clue.text: Study before race meeting

indicators.note: the piece for study is placed before the piece for race in the answer

parts.note: to con is to study or learn by heart
a course is a racecourse, or a race run over one

explanation.surface: Doing your homework before going to a race meeting.
explanation.definitionFit: A gathering or coming together of people is a crowd assembled in one place.

clue.text: Unusual trees, in short

indicators.note: unusual signals that the letters of trees appear in an odd new order

explanation.surface: Uncommon trees described briefly.
explanation.definitionFit: Speech that is concise and brief, cut short, is clipped in manner.

clue.text: Brother, that's a superb cheese!

parts.note: i.e. stands for id est, 'that is'

explanation.surface: Someone exclaiming to their brother about a wonderful cheese.
explanation.definitionFit: A soft French cow's-milk cheese with a white rind, widely admired.

clue.text: Mention the source of information

definitions.meaning: an allusion or mention of something
a book or document consulted for facts

explanation.surface: Citing where the facts came from.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses: an allusion to something, and a work consulted for facts.

clue.text: Plain words about a motorway undertaking

indicators.note: the plain words go around the motorway piece

parts.note: prose is ordinary writing rather than verse, plain words
the M1 is a British motorway, written here as MI

explanation.surface: Straightforward talk about building a motorway.
explanation.walkthrough: The M1 is Britain's main north-south motorway; its 1 stands in as the letter I.
explanation.definitionFit: A pledge or vow is a commitment to do something.

clue.text: The boards going about work quietly due to a strike

indicators.note: the stage goes about, around, the other pieces

parts.note: the boards is theatre slang for the stage
op is short for opus, a work
p is piano, quietly in music

explanation.surface: Actors quietly working around a walkout.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The boards' is a theatre term for the stage; ST and AGE go around OP + P.
explanation.definitionFit: A halt in work by employees is a stopping of labour.

clue.text: Disorder in pound-a place of detention

indicators.note: the disorder piece goes inside the pound piece

parts.note: to baste is to beat or thrash, pound
an ill is an ailment or disorder

explanation.surface: Chaos in an animal pound, a holding place.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Disorder' looks like an anagram signal; it is ILL, an ailment. The Bastille was the Paris prison stormed in 1789.
explanation.definitionFit: The famous Paris fortress-prison, used generally for a jail.

clue.text: The trade tariff affected many

indicators.note: the tariff is affected, changed in shape, so its letters are rearranged

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, so many

explanation.surface: A tariff on commerce hit a lot of people.
explanation.walkthrough: 'affected' rearranges TARIFF into TRAFFI; C for 'many' completes the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Dealing or commerce in goods, often illicit, is buying and selling.

clue.text: Shed for the players

explanation.surface: A hut for the actors.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses: to throw off, as a snake its skin, and the actors in a production.

clue.text: Broken sculpture

explanation.surface: A statue that has been smashed.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses: something ruined or bankrupt, and a carved head-and-shoulders portrait figure.

clue.text: The cad obliged mounted soldiers

parts.note: bound means obliged

indicators.note: in a down clue mounted means going up, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, soldiers

explanation.surface: An ungentlemanly man forced to join the cavalry.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mounted soldiers' suggests cavalry; RE (Royal Engineers) goes upward to give ER.
explanation.definitionFit: An ill-mannered, dishonourable man is a rotter.

clue.text: Minor Shakespearean character producing little effect

definitions.meaning: Francis ... is a woman's tailor recruited in Henry IV Part 2

explanation.surface: A bit-part actor who barely makes an impression.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses: a recruit in Henry IV Part 2, and weak or ineffectual.

clue.text: Stares wildly say

indicators.note: wildly signals the letters of stares are thrown into a different order

explanation.surface: Someone gazing wildly, for example.
explanation.walkthrough: 'say' looks like 'for example'; it is the definition, as a verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To declare or state firmly is to speak out.

clue.text: He takes a little dope, Terence does

indicators.note: the answer takes a little of the letters from the words dope, Terence, running across them

explanation.surface: A man named Terence is confessed to using drugs.
explanation.walkthrough: The run sits across 'dope, Terence'; 'He' is a man's name as definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A man's first name stands for a male person, so a he.

clue.text: Pronounce on the head's good judgement

parts.note: to sound a word is to pronounce it
a ness is a headland, a head of land jutting into the sea

explanation.surface: Commenting on the wisdom of a school head.
explanation.definitionFit: Sound reasoning or being of sound mind means sense and good judgement.

clue.text: Figure skill's essential in this game

definitions.text: Figure skill's essential in this game

parts.words: Figure skill's essential in this game
parts.note: players must reckon scores quickly in their heads as well as throw accurately, so mental arithmetic matters

explanation.surface: Numeracy is needed to play this pub game.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Figure skill' suggests figure skating; it means skill with figures, needed to subtract scores from 501 in this pub game.
explanation.definitionFit: A pub game of throwing pointed missiles at a board, scored by arithmetic.

clue.text: Not upright like the trainee social worker

parts.note: as means like
L is a learner, as on an L-plate
an ant lives and works in a social colony

explanation.surface: A new social worker who is not quite straight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'social worker' suggests a profession; it is the ant, a social insect.
explanation.definitionFit: Leaning at an angle means sloping, not vertical.

clue.text: Delightful broad lea used as it should be

indicators.note: the letters of broad lea are put to proper use, i.e. arranged into a new word

explanation.surface: A broad meadow put to good use is a delight.
explanation.definitionFit: Lovable and charming means very pleasing.

clue.text: A sporting team that's built up one by one

definitions.meaning: a side in cricket or football has this many players

definitions.text: that's built up one by one
definitions.meaning: the figure 11 is written as one beside one

explanation.surface: A team assembled player by player.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses: a cricket or football side, and the number 11 shown as two ones.

clue.text: There's a distinct possibility of observation

definitions.meaning: a likely future event, a chance
a view or outlook seen from a point

explanation.surface: A real chance of being watched.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses: a likelihood of something happening, and a view or vista.
